title: Rules
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
In today’s Bible story 
you will see that the Israelites 
make a WRONG choice
God wants us to be different to the world

WE CAN FOLLOW GOD’s WAYS
or
WE CAN FOLLOW THE WORLD’s WAYS

Watch how the Israelites mess up 
and make a WRONG choice

THEY MAKE A WRONG CHOICE
they worship a golden calf - an IDOL

Let us play opposites
YOU WILL NEED A BEAN BAG or a BALL or TOY
The 10 RULES GOD GAVE TO MOSES

God loves us so much, 
that even if we make WRONG choices, 
He will forgive us if we ask and give us another chance

Dear Lord Jesus
Thank you for loving me
Thank you for giving us the 10 rules
so that I know what is right and wrong
Please help me keep your rules
Amen
